vrf instance CUSTOMER-A
!
vrf instance CUSTOMER-B
!
interface Ethernet3
   description Customer A handoff
   vrf CUSTOMER-A
!
ip route vrf CUSTOMER-A 203.0.113.0/24 192.0.2.10
!
router bgp 65000
   vrf CUSTOMER-A
      rd 65000:100
      route-target import vpn-ipv4 65000:100
      route-target export vpn-ipv4 65000:100
      neighbor 192.0.2.20 remote-as 65100
!
